name: images_depth_map
description: Estimates a DEPTH MAP of an image (Depth Anything 3): near is bright, far is dark. `colormap` grayscale (default) | inferno | viridis | turbo tints it for viewing. Useful as a control image or for parallax/3D effects. Surface maps (normal, roughness…) are `images_pbr_maps`. Then `creations_show`.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

maxSize.description: Cap the longest side (256..4096) before estimating. Default: the model decides.
